title: RULE 0E Gemini-spawn quota unsatisfiable on Freebuff, data for #983/#1020
body: RULE 0E (MANDATES.md:175) mandates minimum 4 thinker-with-files-gemini spawns per complex task. This client exposes no agent-spawn tool, so the quota cannot be executed here; it is satisfiable only on lanes with the thinker agent (Kilo/opencode).
